item.title: Wings over Houston Meet at Greet
item.description:
Friday, July 17, 2026 at 6:30 PM

Location: Tap Room, 941 W 18TH ST., Houston, TX, 77008, United States

Hey photo pit fans, at our first Wings Over Houston Photo Pit meet up we had a nice turnout at the magnificent Eureka Heights Brewery…..so much so, let’s do this again! How does July 17th sound? Sounds great so save the date of July 17th at 6:00pm till 9:00pm at the wonderful Eureka Heights Brewery. Let’s all meet up talk airshow and photography. We will have airshow performers in attendance to ask questions to about how they fly the airshow and any other questions you have……….like what is their favorite food? J Of course, the Amazing Photo Pit Team and movers and shakers of the airshow staff will be there for your questions and entertainment. Please feel free to ask any of us behind the scenes questions. Please RSVP.

From Eureka Heights Brewery
